subtopics.title: Hyperparameter Search Strategies
subtopics.summary: Methods for exploring the hyperparameter space, including grid search, random search, and Bayesian optimization, to identify configurations that improve model convergence and performance.

subtopics.title: Learning Rate Scheduling
subtopics.summary: Techniques for adjusting the learning rate during training, such as warmup, cosine decay, and step decay, to stabilize convergence and improve final model accuracy.

subtopics.title: Batch Size and Resource Trade-offs
subtopics.summary: The impact of batch size on training speed, memory usage, gradient stability, and hardware utilization, including how to select batch sizes based on available compute resources.
